mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits CYP2D6, reducing flecainide metabolism and increasing its cardiotoxic plasma concentrations, combined with additive cardiac conduction effects.
action: Avoid this combination; if necessary, use alternative antiarrhythmic agent not metabolized by CYP2D6 (e.g., amiodarone) and monitor cardiac function closely with baseline and serial ECGs.
